Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

In case of payment to nominees, if the nominees are liable to the Government by incurring any debt after the death of the subscriber, the amounts payable to the nominees are liable to attachment and if the debts are due to the Government, they may be made good by adjusting from the  
PF dues to the nominees.
